[[File:Ossic_building_Pau_City.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Obi-Wan's [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's blue Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] arriving on the Civic Level]]
The '''Civic Level''' on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] was where [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City's]] [[Governor/Legends|governors]] and leaders had their offices, they also lived there. Along with the [[Wealth Level/Legends|Wealth Level]] this was the most populated level of Pau City.
